properties.title: Croatia — 2015
properties.description: Field boundaries of the 2015 edition of this dataset, one GeoParquet file (`hr-2015.parquet`, 1,283,594 fields) and its PMTiles. Partition `year=2015` of the collection's hive layout.

table:columns.name: rp
table:columns.description: RP flag (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: ot_nat
table:columns.description: Other nature flag (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: irrigation_source
table:columns.description: Irrigation source code (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: slope
table:columns.description: Average slope (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: natura2000_povs
table:columns.description: Natura 2000 POVS overlap (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: hcat:name_en
table:columns.description: The original crop name translated into English. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name
table:columns.description: The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop (Hierarchical Crop and Agriculture Taxonomy, EuroCrops). ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: anc_area
table:columns.description: ANC area (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: irrigation_type
table:columns.description: Irrigation type code (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: mines_year_removed
table:columns.description: Year mines were removed (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: home_name
table:columns.description: Locality / home name (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: mines_status
table:columns.description: Mine contamination status (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: water_protect_zone
table:columns.description: Water protection zone code (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: collection
table:columns.description: The identifier of the collection. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: anc
table:columns.description: Area with Natural Constraints flag (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: natura2000
table:columns.description: Natura 2000 overlap area (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: ot_nat_area
table:columns.description: Other nature area (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: natura2000_pop
table:columns.description: Natura 2000 POP overlap (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: height
table:columns.description: Average elevation (mapped to `height`) (source column `z_avg`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: jpaid
table:columns.description: Unique single application identifier (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: metrics:perimeter
table:columns.description: Perimeter of the field, in meters (m). Must be > 0 and <= 125,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: An identifier for the field. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:code
table:columns.description: The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop. The first 4, 6, 8 digits select increasingly specific crop groups. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: irrigation
table:columns.description: Irrigation flag (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: tvpv
table:columns.description: TVPV flag (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: eligibility_coef
table:columns.description: Eligibility coefficient (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: natura2000_ok
table:columns.description: Natura 2000 status (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: sanitary_protection_zone
table:columns.description: Sanitary protection zone code (per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))
